name: Black dragon hide
description: A tanned black hide rolled and tied with cord, hard as boot leather and still set with rows of dark green scales. It shrugs off acid.
notes: A roll 500 mm long and 100 mm across with the spiral showing at both ends, a loose edge along the front, two cord ties and three rows of scales on top. The bundle variant rides on this model and carries its own mass (25 kg, ten hides). The hide is `hide-dragon-black`; the scales left on it keep `scale-dragon`'s dark green so they read against the black.

name: Black dragon hide (curing)
description: A raw black hide rolled flesh side in, crusted with salt and bound with twine while it cures. It can be unrolled once it is done.
notes: The curing state of black_dragon_hide, a distinct look, so it gets its own model: the same 500 by 100 mm roll in the same black hide, its raw flesh side showing at the ends and along the loose edge, salt crust on top and three twine ties. The timed curing and the unroll action are left to the item framework.

name: Black dragon scale
description: A single glossy black scale the size of a palm, heavy for its size, with a dark green keel down the middle. Acid does not mark it.
notes: A scale 110 by 90 mm and 8 mm thick, curved across its width, round at the root and tapering to a blunt point, with a keel and two side ridges. The scale is glossy `chitin-black` and the keel `scale-dragon`. CHECK VOLUME (x4): the box of a curved plate is mostly air; the solid is about 60 ml against the reference 75 ml. The bundle variant rides on this model with its own mass (3.8 kg, ten scales).

name: Glowing rune scroll
description: A scroll of heavy paper rolled on a wooden rod, tied with red ribbon and sealed in wax. The runes on its open edge glow violet. Reading it takes you somewhere else and back, once.
notes: A roll 300 mm long and 50 mm across on a rod with turned knobs, 372 mm end to end, with a leaf unrolled at the front showing 24 violet runes. CHECK VOLUME (x4.2): the unrolled leaf fills the bounding box; the roll itself holds about 590 ml against the reference 500 ml. The name avoids the mod's place name; the teleport is left to the item framework.

name: Small blue potion
description: A corked, wax-sealed round glass flask about two thirds full of a faintly glowing blue liquid.
notes: A round-bellied flask 122 mm tall and 80 mm across with a flat foot, a cork and a red wax seal; the liquid stands just proud of the glass so it shows on the tile, which draws the glass opaque. A liquid is one item with its container, so the mass is the reference 265 g whole and the volume flag is the flask's box. Every potion variant rides on this flask; the reference gives no liquid colours, so each variant can add a finishes map on slot liquid when its colour is chosen. The name avoids the mod's word for magic.

name: Bone syringe
description: A hollow leg bone broken off and ground to a slanted point, a red rune cut along its shaft and a dark plug sealing the knuckle end. It holds one dose to jab into yourself.
notes: A bone 200 mm long, 26 mm across at the knuckle, tapering to a point with its bore showing at the broken end, a line of red rune marks on top and a purple plug of stored sludge. The reference's butchering quality is left out: a syringe is not a butchering tool. The name avoids the mod's school name; the caster boost is left to the item framework.

name: Rune-banded steel syringe
description: A sturdy steel syringe with a brass plunger, its barrel ringed with three carved red bands and rune marks. It holds one dose of dark green sludge.
notes: Built on h.syringe: a barrel 90 mm long and 18 mm across, 204 mm from thumb ring to the end of its steel cap, with three red rune bands and two glyphs. The name avoids the mod's school name; the caster boost is left to the item framework.

name: Rune candle
description: A thick ivory candle with a band of runes cut into its side that glow pale blue. It burns faster than a plain candle.
notes: An unlit candle 90 mm tall and 60 mm across with a cupped top, a black wick, two wax runs and five glowing blue runes over an underline on its front. The reference material is beeswax; wax-ivory stands in. A lit state would get its own model when the light framework needs one. The name avoids the mod's school name.
